top_n_used_for_features.rule: products with >= min_pos positives in the train basis rows; capped at max_labels by frequency
top_n_used_for_features.reason: compute budget: 9035 products satisfy min_pos=20, kept the 5000 most frequent

H1.criterion: max w_j over the top-N used for LightGBM >= 1e3 (all products >= 1e4)

H2.criterion: dead labels >= 1 in a 30% calibration split of the test rows (mean of 10 seeds), top-N

H3.criterion: weighted LightGBM: fraction of validation cells at exactly 1.0 >= 0.05 (benchmark labels)

recommended_N.rule: largest candidate with H1 and projected night-1 hours <= 20.0
